confidence_notes: Six web searches were used: one for the RBA rate and five for prices. Restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino anchors rest on several aggregated cost-of-living sources that roughly agree. Those were Numbeo-derived figures, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, BorderlyAI and Expatistan. Inexpensive meal is about CNY 28 (about USD 4), draft beer about CNY 15-20, cappuccino about CNY 25-35 and a mid-range dinner for two about CNY 200. Some of these pages are dated, and sources disagree on exact figures. No reliable Suzhou-specific price was found for cocktail or wine by the glass. Those two are estimated from the local beer price and from Chinese tier-1 and tier-2 city bar pricing. Wine is also informed by Expatistan's roughly CNY 183 per bottle of good red wine. Both drink anchors are low-confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Suzhou as a heavily visited domestic tourist city. No accommodation searches or live listings were checked. The FX figure came from a search result summarising RBA exchange-rate pages, not from a direct read of the RBA table. The same search also returned older July 2026 values, so the as-of date and rate should be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Suzhou is a wealthy Yangtze River Delta tourist city next to Shanghai and Hangzhou. Food prices are modestly above the China average, and accommodation is cheaper than Shanghai. Cocktail and wine anchors were scaled from Hangzhou and Shanghai bar benchmarks and from Suzhou beer prices.
